item.title: Foster care payments in Louisiana to rise, says DCFS
item.description: Louisiana’s Department of Children and Family Services (DCFS) is seeking a 50% increase in foster care payments to better support families and recruit more foster parents.

item.title: Louisiana unveils first nuclear energy strategic framework

item.title: Arkansas Rep. Stan Berry dead at 71
item.description: Arkansas Rep. Stan Berry, a 71-year-old Republican, passed away on January 9, 2023, after serving in the Arkansas legislature, the National Guard, and various other roles in the community.
